user.title: Connect your Nest account
user.description:
In a Firefox private window, sign in at home.nest.com with the Network tab open, filter for 'issueToken', right-click the 'iframerpc' request and choose Copy Value > Copy as cURL. Paste it below, then close the window without signing out. Use a separate sign-in from any other tool using these credentials.

{problem}

data.capture: Copied iframerpc request (cURL), or the issue token URL and cookies on two lines

error.bad_capture: That doesn't look like the iframerpc request.
error.rejected: Google rejected these credentials. Capture them again in a new Firefox private window.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Google or Nest. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Nest account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials belong to a different Nest account.
